definitions.explanation: A deep, dark shade of brown, like the color of something slightly scorched. One of the standard Japanese color terms.

examples.japanese: こげ{茶色|ちゃいろ}の{靴|くつ}を{買|か}った。
{壁|かべ}をこげ{茶色|ちゃいろ}に{塗|ぬ}り{替|か}えた。
examples.english: I repainted the wall dark brown.

examples.japanese: こげ{茶色|ちゃいろ}の{革|かわ}のバッグは、どんな{服|ふく}にも{合|あ}わせやすい。
examples.english: A dark brown leather bag is easy to coordinate with any outfit.

notes:
A standard color term combining こげ (scorched, burnt) with {茶色|ちゃいろ} (brown). Often written in hiragana for the first part. Sometimes abbreviated to こげ{茶|ちゃ}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- こげ{茶色|ちゃいろ}の{髪|かみ}: dark brown hair
- こげ{茶色|ちゃいろ}の{家具|かぐ}: dark brown furniture
- こげ{茶色|ちゃいろ}の{革靴|かわぐつ}: dark brown leather shoes

RELATED COLOR TERMS:
- {茶色|ちゃいろ}: brown — the basic brown
- {薄茶色|うすちゃいろ}: light brown, tan
- {栗色|くりいろ}: chestnut brown — slightly reddish brown

ETYMOLOGY:
こげ comes from {焦|こ}げる (to scorch/burn). The color resembles the dark shade of something that has been lightly scorched.
